utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’d be wonderful — thanks for spreading the word. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Just keep me posted when you hear anything, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Eli — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I can start on the front gate and then check the shelves after. Just point me to the tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check in on what the repair drive still needs and pass along any updates. Just let me know if you need me to grab anything while I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. If you can bring a screwdriver and a hammer, I’m set to start on the gate.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t confirmed it yet, but I can check with a couple people first. If they’re okay with it, the community center lot seems like the easiest drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Rey. Thanks for checking and keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll ask a couple people and let you know what they think.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still need the wrench set and a replacement hose, and tomorrow afternoon works if you want to drop by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — the repair drive is at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right beside the library entrance. If you’re coming tomorrow afternoon, Oak Avenue is usually the easiest access.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Maple Street by the library, and Oak Avenue for tomorrow afternoon. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — we’ve got a wobbly front gate and a couple of loose shelves that need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the tools and supplies we’ll need for the gate and shelves first, then I’ll tell you what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Hana — thanks for checking. Let me know what we still need, and I’ll help track it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, thanks — could you check what tools and supplies we still need first? I’ve been a bit scattered, so that seems like the best place to start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check what tools and supplies we still need first and let you know. Then we can fill any gaps before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — that really helps. Just let me know what’s missing when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll check in at the repair drive while I’m out and let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I appreciate you checking in and letting me know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll stop by and report back once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — you can borrow both. Just bring them back when you’re done, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll borrow both and bring them back once I’m done. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still think we should confirm with the organizer first before I say anything else. Once we know the details, I can help pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — let’s confirm with the organizer first, and then we can tell people the community center lot if it’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s the safest plan — I’ll wait for confirmation before sharing anything else.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll mention it to a few more neighbors and see who can chip in or volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’m keeping a list of what everyone can bring, so just send folks my way if they want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send anyone interested your way and spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right beside the library entrance. If I’m coming after the school run, Oak Avenue sounds like the easiest access.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Maple Street by the library entrance — got it. I’ll bring the toolbox and screws, and I’ll swing by Oak Avenue after the school run if that’s easiest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll plan for that and meet you there after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair list coming together, and I’ll share the schedule as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — that really helps. I’m still catching up, so I’ll watch for your schedule update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the schedule as soon as it’s finalized, and I’ll flag any changes along the way.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
